tasks.completion_summary: Exposed skip-tls-verify + listen-port on .agnt.kdl ProxyConfig. internal/config/agnt.go adds both fields with docstrings pinning the strict semantics. internal/proxy/server.go adds StrictListenPort flag on both ProxyConfig and ProxyServer; Start() honors it so strict-listen-port bind conflicts fail hard with a 'strict listen port <addr> in use' error instead of silently drifting to :0. internal/daemon/proxy_events.go factors a buildProxyServerConfig helper that maps .agnt.kdl ProxyConfig -> proxy.ProxyConfig (ListenPort>0 -> strict mode on; ListenPort<=0 -> -1 hash-based allocator; SkipTLSVerify pass-through); all three event handlers (handleURLDetected, handleExplicitStart, handleFallbackPortCheck) now delegate to it. internal/daemon/daemon_autostart.go autostartProxy pre-flights explicit listen-port conflicts via config.FindPIDsByPort + config.ProcessNameByPID and emits a proxy_listen_port_conflict startupErrorStore entry with port + owner hint before enqueueing ExplicitStart, so the AI agent sees both the diagnosis and the hard runtime failure. examples/.agnt.kdl gains a commented tdo-dev example (url https + listen-port 4444 + skip-tls-verify true) plus an expanded PROXY OPTIONS REFERENCE block documenting listen-port, skip-tls-verify, and bind. Tests: internal/config/agnt_test.go adds TestParseProxyListenPortAndSkipTLSVerify (5 sub-tests), TestProxyListenPortExplicitTargetAutostart, TestProxyListenPortBadValueCoercesToZero (kdl-go coerces bad int to 0 -> hash allocator fallback documented). internal/proxy/port_test.go adds TestProxyServer_StrictListenPort_ConflictFailsHard + TestProxyServer_NonStrictListenPort_FallsBack. internal/daemon/proxy_events_test.go adds TestBuildProxyServerConfig (6 sub-tests), TestHandleExplicitStart_ListenPortAndTLSVerify, TestAutostartProxy_ListenPortConflict_EmitsStartupError, TestAutostartProxy_NoListenPort_NoPreflightError. go vet + gofmt + make test green; -race clean on internal/config + internal/proxy + internal/daemon. Plan adjustment: added the StrictListenPort flag mid-implementation after spotting the silent :0 fallback in Start() that would defeat the whole feature if left unchanged.
